limits: One small perception probe per model, not a global latency or gameplay benchmark.
Non-input elapsed time includes model decisions, tool waits, pauses and other unclassified overhead.
A fresh prompt and model change are combined; later comparison cannot isolate the model alone.
Game progression and difficulty are unchanged.

timingCorrection.interpretation: Unattributed no-input gap; exclude from active-decision latency comparison, do not call it model inference time.

selectedModelReason: Only tested candidate to return correct native visual coordinates and move slot on the original probe; not a claim of globally fastest model.
